meta.title: Suggestions register — improve decision making before anything is implemented
workflow: 1. Anyone adds a suggestion with rationale, expected impact and affected files/pages.
2. The reviewer (site owner) marks each suggestion: accepted / rejected / needs-info / implemented. Nothing is implemented before it is accepted.
3. Accepted suggestions are ordered by the priority column and executed in a separate change with its own verification pass.
4. Implemented suggestions keep their ID and gain a link to the change that implemented them.
5. Rejected suggestions stay on the page with the rejection reason, so decisions are auditable.

statusLegend.accepted: approved for a future change — NOT yet implemented
statusLegend.implemented: done, with a link to the change
statusLegend.needs-info: decision blocked on a question in questions.json

reviewBoard.reviewCadence: weekly during the NFL season; monthly otherwise
reviewBoard.rule: A suggestion may only move to accepted when its linked questions (if any) are answered or explicitly waived.

suggestions.title: Add a verified market-odds data source and closing-line archive
suggestions.rationale: Gates G5/G6, unit-profit scoring and CLV cannot run without recorded lines; this is the single biggest blocker in the questions register (Q-ODDS).
suggestions.impact: Unlocks monetary grading, CLV tracking, and realistic parlay pricing.

suggestions.title: Automate weekly injury-report ingestion in GitHub Actions
suggestions.rationale: Injury rows are currently a 2026-11-13 snapshot; the deficiency model needs every week's report to grade S3 and compute injury-signal correlations.
suggestions.impact: Season-long injury history; live deficiency flags; S3 becomes gradable.

suggestions.title: Ingest official team depth charts to mark 1st/2nd/3rd/4th string
suggestions.rationale: The league injury report does not publish depth tier. Team official depth charts do. Without them, backup-tier deficiencies cannot be labelled verified (Q-DEPTH).
suggestions.impact: Verified starter-vs-backup deficiency labels for all 32 teams.

suggestions.title: Publish an odds-free forecast track record alongside the lines
suggestions.rationale: Brier/MAE grading works today with verified results; a public track record builds evidence before any money-graded system exists.
suggestions.impact: Continuous validation without waiting for Q-ODDS.

suggestions.title: Add per-week model refresh to the site build pipeline
suggestions.rationale: model.json is generated by scripts/nfl_intel.py; wiring it into the documented rebuild order prevents drift between data and pages.

suggestions.title: Create a pick-submission format (JSON schema) for leaderboard entries
suggestions.rationale: Pre-registration only works if submissions are machine-readable and timestamped.
suggestions.impact: Enables G1/G7 enforcement and automated grading.

suggestions.title: Add weather data for totals origination (official airport observations)
suggestions.rationale: Wind/precipitation move totals; the totals model currently uses pace only.
suggestions.impact: Better totals; one more pre-registered signal for correlation testing.

suggestions.title: Track official inactives 90 minutes pre-kickoff
suggestions.rationale: Game-status designations on Friday are not the final word; official inactives are. This is the true availability signal for S3.
suggestions.impact: Removes designation noise from the injury signal.

suggestions.title: Add snap-count ingestion (official gamebooks) to verify who actually replaced whom
suggestions.rationale: A 'backup' label is static; snap counts prove on-field replacement (2nd/3rd/4th string usage) after the fact (Q-SNAPS).

suggestions.title: Dashboard card: 'originate vs market' comparison once odds exist
suggestions.rationale: The most useful decision view is our number vs the market number with the gap highlighted; it cannot be built honestly until SG-01 lands.

suggestions.title: Leaderboard page with sortable gate results per strategy
suggestions.rationale: Requested deliverable; the design is in strategies.json and the pilot board is on nfl-strategies.html.
suggestions.note: Accepted by default as an explicit owner requirement (2026-11-13 brief); implementation = nfl-strategies.html in this change.

suggestions.title: Weekly executive-summary auto-refresh from model.json + injuries
suggestions.rationale: The executive summary should never drift from the data it summarizes.
suggestions.impact: One-page current picture at all times.

suggestions.title: Add a 'confidence label' column to every analytical table
suggestions.rationale: Owner requirement: every value is verified / computed / unverified at a glance.
suggestions.impact: No unlabelled numbers on the site.
suggestions.implementedBy: this change — all NFL intel tables carry verified/computed/unverified labels and source links

suggestions.title: Record every model formula on the page that shows its output
suggestions.rationale: Owner requirement: no hallucinations; formulas make computed values auditable.
suggestions.impact: Anyone can reproduce spreads and totals from the committed data.

suggestions.title: Legal review of the reward structure before accepting external entries
suggestions.rationale: Rewards tied to betting performance may be regulated; the 2027 open season must not launch without a compliance answer (Q-LEGAL).
